name: Nessus
title: Nessus: The Ninth Layer
description: Nessus is the ninth and deepest layer of the Nine Hells, a realm of bottomless ravines and jagged canyons.
wiki: Nessus is the personal domain of Asmodeus, the Archlord of the Nine Hells. It is here, in the Malsheem, that he orchestrates the grand schemes that influence the entire multiverse.
